recommended_edit: There is no semantics-preserving single edit that defeats all survivors: the shared reduction is an intrinsic consequence of the immutable identifiers and the perfect-square rule. To defeat these implementations, the task itself must use a non-equivalent edge compatibility rule rather than perfect-square products, or add a structural restriction/requirement that changes the problem.
regression_risk: Changing the compatibility rule could also make qwen3-coder's exhaustive search correct in principle, though it would likely remain impractical at the stated bounds.
